note: Pondera County's unincorporated land is not zoned (2011 growth policy). The cities that zone publish their zoning only as PDF maps (Conrad's Zoning Map PDF; Valier's zoning-map page, apparently a PDF or viewer). Conrad has an ArcGIS Online parcel layer with a ZONING field (conradmt/Conrad_Zoning), but it returns 'Token Required' to anonymous queries, so it cannot be read. No queryable zoning district polygon layer for Pondera County or its towns was found; the Frontier Zoning Atlas layers contain no Pondera features.
